name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.label_le
typeText:
∀ (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) (x : Nat),
  Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.nodes (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.network g))
      x →
    LE.le.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.natC x) (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.labelB g)

source.code:
theorem label_le (x : ℕ) (hx : x ∈ g.network.nodes) : natC x ≤ g.labelB := by
  rw [g.mem_netNodes] at hx
  unfold labelB
  apply natC_mono
  rcases hx with ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ | ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ | rfl | rfl
  · have := g.reps_lt r hr; omega
  · have := g.reps_lt r hr; omega
  · simp [netS]
  · simp [netT]
